summary: Diagnosed the shell-test-suite non-determinism: no defect found in task-lock.sh or run-all.sh (task-lock.sh uses a genuinely atomic mkdir mutex; every consumer test correctly scopes it to an isolated scratch tree; run-all.sh never acquires a lock). Two concrete, 100%-deterministic (not race-condition) defects were found and reproduced standalone with zero concurrent load, fully explaining the observed run-to-run inconsistency: (1) test-validate-return-meta.sh hardcodes a live specs/052_return_meta_artifacts_shape_contract path that was archived by /todo on 2026-08-17 (commit 8a104a17c); (2) test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh's skill_cleanup case still asserts a 3-file cleanup contract that was deliberately changed to 2 files the same day (commit 75ec7bfa6, documented in the function's own header comment). A validated isolation fix (REPO_ROOT override + scratch .claude/scripts copy, mirroring test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh's own build_fixture_repo() pattern) is provided for (1); a one-line assertion correction is provided for (2). Two full concurrent run-all.sh runs at the current commit both produced the identical result (50 passed, 2 failed -- exactly these two suites), confirming the suite is already consistent under concurrency once these two fixture-staleness bugs are fixed.

artifacts.summary: Full diagnosis, evidence, and validated fixes for the two confirmed deterministic test-fixture-staleness defects, plus task-lock.sh/run-all.sh review findings (no defect).
